'''Rilllrrnnn''' was a kind of edible [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] used them to garnish [[Salad/Legends|salads]], which were served at [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] [[Funeral of Chewbacca|funeral]].
